subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Information Is Power
description: A fast breakdown of Information Is Power for builders.

hook.text: Arab spice traders kept routes secret for centuries. Information asymmetry was their business model.

buildup.text: Throughout history, those who controlled trade information held power over markets and prices.

discovery.text: Today, real-time data sharing levels the field. Visibility tools give everyone access to the same facts.

twist.text: Companies still hoard data from partners. Trust gaps remain the biggest barrier to supply chain visibility.

climax.text: The shift from secrecy to transparency is ongoing. Those who share data win together.

punchline.text: Secrets built old empires. Sharing builds new ones.

quiz.question: What is the biggest barrier to supply chain visibility?
